image.caption: Fireworks accompany festive celebrations around the world. (Credit: modification of work by tlc, Flickr)

introduction.p: The trajectories of fireworks are modeled by quadratic equations. The equations can be used to predict the maximum height of a firework and the number of seconds it will take from launch to explosion. In this chapter, we will study the properties of quadratic equations, solve them, graph them, and see how they are applied as models of various situations.
